serverCrossCheck.method: execute if biome <cell-centre> minecraft:<biome> run say <token>
serverCrossCheck.decodedGridAtSection19: beach at (2, 3), ocean elsewhere; the same x/z cell pattern was decoded in sections 7, 8 and 10
notes: Cell centres use world coordinates x = -32 + cellX * 4 + 1 and z = -48 + cellZ * 4 + 1.
This cross-check validates block biome cell order against the running game for sections that contain terrain.

emptyHighSectionObservation.interpretation: The adapter reports stored NBT faithfully. The running server appears to ignore stored biome cells in this section without terrain. This must be rechecked before biome editing and is not used as cell-order evidence.

limitations: The world and server output are not committed; only this summary is recorded.
